data.binder.epitope: Linear epitope within ILVDLFNDQYLEDNVTAPDYMKNVLVLTLS (SEQ ID NO:225); region of overlap among bound peptides: LEDNVTAPDY (SEQ ID NO:314)
data.binder.binding_site: GCC peptides 55 and 56 of the 20-mer peptide array (GCC aa 1-440)

data.citation: US 8,785,600 B2, "Anti-GCC antibody molecules and related compositions and methods", granted 2014-07-22

experimental_conditions.assay: cell-surface binding to GCC ECD truncation mutants (FL mature peptide and 8 truncations: d1-32, d1-49, d1-94, d1-128, d1-177, d1-226, d1-279, d1-229, d1-379) expressed as FLAG-tagged constructs (pFLAG-CMV-3) in 293 cells, followed by immunoprecipitation with the anti-GCC antibody and Western blotting for the FLAG epitope
experimental_conditions.source_section: Example 1, Cell Surface Binding to GCC Truncation Mutants

data.binder.epitope: Likely a conformational epitope formed by the presence of amino acids 33 to 50 of human GCC; 5F9 binds cells with the d1-32 mutation but not cells with the d1-49 mutation
data.binder.binding_site: Human GCC amino acids 33-50 (binding lost when the protein is truncated between aa 33-50)

binder.species_reactivity.note: the rat and mouse GCC sequences are identical to human GCC in the aa 33-50 region
